name: DIALOG
recent: Dialog 在最新季度（截至2026年9月30日）净利按年增长近18%至RM165mil，并已启动Salbiah气田生产，同时投资US$211m于Fatimah油田。近期公告以EPF与KWAP的大股东持股变动为主，另有数项「OTHERS」公告。
notable: 最新季度净利按年增长近18%至RM165mil。
risks: EPF与KWAP在近期多日出现大股东持股变动申报。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收RM774.6mil，净利RM167.5mil，净利率21.6%；营收按季增11.2%、按年增27.3%，净利按季增12.9%、按年增13.6%。

recent_en: Dialog's latest quarter (ended 30 Sep 2026) net profit rose nearly 18% year-on-year to RM165mil, and it has started Salbiah gas production while investing US$211m in the Fatimah field. Recent announcements were mainly substantial shareholder changes by EPF and KWAP, plus several 'OTHERS' announcements.
notable_en: Latest quarter net profit rose nearly 18% year-on-year to RM165mil.
Invested US$211m in the Fatimah field.
risks_en: EPF and KWAP filed multiple substantial shareholder changes over recent days.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM774.6mil and net income RM167.5mil, with a net margin of 21.6%; revenue rose 11.2% QoQ and 27.3% YoY, while net income rose 12.9% QoQ and 13.6% YoY.
